assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background for a 2D side scrolling Gothic hand inked storybook game. Intricate hand painted aged surfaces, charcoal outlines, muted blue teal with restrained amber light. FULLY OPAQUE rectangular background, no transparency, no floating cutout panels, no text, no UI, no characters, no playable platforms baked in. A SINGLE CONTINUOUS VERY TALL PORTRAIT wall elevation, fill every edge. Top, middle and bottom belong to same physical shaft but have clearly DIFFERENT architectural landmarks. Straight on orthographic elevation, not a perspective tunnel, not a three panel collage. Wax museum service shaft: top has dusty display-gallery stained glass and cabinets behind masonry, middle has heavy riveted ventilation ducts, connected iron galleries and wax storage niches, bottom has furnace refractory stone and warm amber oven slits with cooled wax channels. Continuous structural pillars bind all levels together. Camera will move UP and DOWN across this image. Very tall portrait composition. Distant depth, no bright foreground.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 2x2 character animation pose atlas using the supplied Morris image as the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference, not as a background. Same elderly gaunt wax sculptor, swept tied grey hair, long grey pointed beard, burned left face with orange glowing eye, burgundy old coat, dirty beige apron, dripping gold wax shoulder portraits and candles, boots. Hand inked gothic 2D game art. ALL FOUR fully visible separate full-body poses facing LEFT, same body size and baseline within each quadrant, generous transparent gutters, RGBA background. TOP LEFT anticipation: lowers body and pulls large molten wax claw far back above shoulder. TOP RIGHT active: powerful low horizontal sweep, elongated wax claw reaching LEFT, coat swings right. BOTTOM LEFT casting: upright body with both palms projecting a wax sphere LEFT, arched bent knees. BOTTOM RIGHT ground slam: crouching with giant wax fist planted to the LEFT on floor level, wax splashes tightly around fist. No ground plane, no text, no UI, no grid lines. Each body including arm fits entirely within own cell. No semi-transparent character.
